enquiry: We handle a petroleum stream and currently send samples to a laboratory for water determination. We want to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process so that changes can be noticed sooner. The analyzer would be outside the process area. Before selecting equipment, we need to know what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish.

items.finding: The source notes that attenuated total reflection probes allow in-line measurements in demanding environments and reaction mixtures.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests testing whether ATR probes can withstand the petroleum stream conditions while monitoring water concentration.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study discusses chlorosilanes or strong acids and bases rather than petroleum streams, so matrix effects and chemical compatibility must be verified.

citation.quote: Attenuated total reflection probes (ATR) allow in-line measurements even in demanding measurement environments and reaction mixtures with highly oxidative and corrosive substances, such as chlorosilanes or strong acids and bases.
